name: teams-get-channel-spo-urls
title: Retrieving SharePoint Site URL for Teams Channels
shortDescription: Identify the SharePoint URLs associated with Microsoft Teams channels using either PnP PowerShell or CLI for Microsoft 365.
longDescription: Retrieve the SharePoint sites of private and shared channels for eDiscovery or reporting. Teams can have up to 30 private channels and many shared channels, so this script collates their SharePoint URLs.
